LanguageData.LawAndOrder_Alert_CourtroomNeededDesc:
You have prisoners awaiting hearings, but no courtroom has been set up.

To create a courtroom, you need:
 - An enclosed room (indoors)
 - At least one chair designated as Judge seat
 - At least one chair designated as Defendant seat

Select chairs in a room and use the 'Designate Chair Role' button to set up courtroom seating.
